tagline: Join Kayra Creation and help shape the future of fine jewelry design, from strategy to the storefront.

jobs.mailAddress: HR Kayra Creation Inc, 71 W 4th Street, Suite 1305, New York, NY 10036

duties.title: Design & Market Research
points: Research and evaluate jewelry design trends, material innovations and consumer purchasing behavior
Guide data-driven product development with analytical findings
Monitor market trends and consumer preference data for new product development and long-term portfolio expansion

duties.title: Sales & Brand Strategy
points: Review historical sales performance, customer feedback, pricing structures and competitive market conditions
Inform design direction, collection planning and brand positioning strategies
Assess existing collections, manufacturing processes and design standards for consistency with brand identity, quality control and target market expectations

duties.title: Supplier Management
points: Collaborate with domestic and international suppliers to source materials and components
Evaluate quality benchmarks and negotiate pricing, lead times and contractual terms
Analyze supplier performance metrics to optimize cost efficiency, maintain production timelines and ensure material quality

duties.title: Inventory Management
points: Analyze stock levels and identify high-performing and underperforming product categories
Coordinate production adjustments to optimize supply-demand balance

duties.title: E-commerce Support
points: Support development and implementation of a B2C e-commerce platform
Provide functional jewelry design to maximize accessibility and minimize bounce rate

jobs.summary: Guide data-driven jewelry product development through research, supplier collaboration and design strategy.
requirements: Master's degree in Design Management or a related major
Travel 5 to 6 times per year, 4 to 5 days each, within the US or internationally
Participate in jewelry trade shows and market field research
